title: Run Monte Carlo elongation simulations
action: Implement the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) energy functional and the canonical Monte Carlo Metropolis algorithm. For each required condition (metal = Ag, Au, Pd, Pt at T = 300 K with Q = 0 eV and Q = 1.0 eV, plus Ag at T = 100 K with Q = 0.4 eV), set up an initial 96-atom nanowire configuration with fixed (100) planes. Run the elongation simulation with 100,000 MC steps per 0.1 Å separation step until rupture. Record total energy vs separation distance and atomic positions.
description: Simulation logs documenting the MC runs.

title: Extract breaking distances and LAC formation
action: From the simulation outputs, determine for each condition the elongation distance at nanowire rupture (d_break, in Angstrom) and whether a linear atomic chain of at least 5 atoms formed (LAC_formed). Produce a results.json file containing one object per condition.
description: Breaking distance and linear atomic chain formation for all required conditions.
output_schema: A JSON array of objects with fields: metal (string), temperature_K (integer), Q_eV (float), d_break_Angstrom (float), LAC_formed (boolean).
